description: This file contains utility functions for making HTTP requests, handling responses, error transformation, and related helper functions within the Notesnook project. It defines methods for GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE requests, and manages JSON and form data payloads.

classes.name: RequestError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling request-related errors, including error code and data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with optional authorization token.

methods.name: deleteRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified URL with optional authorization token.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with form data payload.

methods.name: patch.json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request with JSON payload.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with form data payload.

methods.name: post.json
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON payload.

methods.name: errorTransformer
methods.description: Transforms error JSON responses into a standardized error object with description and code.

methods.name: fetchWrapped
methods.description: Wraps fetch call with error handling for network issues and server responses.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes fetch responses, parsing JSON or text, handling errors, and publishing events for unauthorized access.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates request headers, including Authorization if token is provided.

methods.name: transformFormData
methods.description: Converts data object into URL-encoded form data string.
